children: Shares of Beta Bionics slid after the company priced its underwritten public offering.
The stock fell 5.8% to $18.11 in premarket trading on Wednesday. At Tuesday's market close, shares were down 37% this year.
The medical device company said it would offer about 7.7 million shares of its common stock at $17.25 per share, plus pre-funded warrants to purchase shares for certain investors.
The company expects gross proceeds from the offering of $150 million. The company had previously proposed a $125 million underwritten public offering.
The company said it would use the proceeds of the offering for general corporate purposes, which could include costs associated with commercializing its tubeless insulin patch pump Mint.
The company expects the offering to close Sept. 17.
Beta Bionics also granted the offering's underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 1.3 million additional shares at the public offering price.
